spec.title: Apply CloudPainter Runtime Safety
spec.what: Apply only Runtime Safety to existing API and both Vite services and actual photo/outline test harness callers, preserving original native scope and all C01–C12 obligations.
spec.why: Reject wrong ports, eliminate unsafe readiness and TERM-only cleanup, and prove real caller activation without disrupting managed services.
done: API, CloudPainter and development sandbox listeners use the configured environment/platform port, reject invalid values before listening, and never silently switch to a different port when the configured one is busy. Existing artifact routes, base paths and managed service ownership remain intact.

Actual self-starting CloudPainter test harnesses share a canonical owned-server lifecycle with collision handling, finite service-specific readiness, bounded output and verified termination of their owned wrappers/descendants. Concurrent independent tests do not receive the same live reservation or stop unrelated listeners; externally supplied previews are treated as unowned.

The delivered repository scanner passes with narrowly evidenced classifications, not blanket fixture/documentation exclusions. Actual startup/health/cleanup callers are covered by required executable assertions, rather than only unused helpers or package fixtures.

Newly activated controls pass two complete consecutive runs of the one admitted existing tier without manual port, process or lease clearing between runs. Unknown ownership, surviving children, cancellation or missing evidence remain non-successful and do not authorize takeover or premature release.

A requirement-to-delivery handoff records capabilities, canonical source/input identities, actual wiring, tests, both run outcomes and remaining limitations. The absent safe development-restart capability is evidenced as ineligible; no outage/restart UI, Help, Admin Analytics, deployment or live-service disruption is introduced.
outOfScope: Help/onboarding, Admin Analytics, product design/features, new artifacts, image/provider changes, user data/auth/quota/backups, a new outage/restart API or UI, and deployment/production operations. No existing listener reclaim, uncertain lease deletion, broad process-name killing, live service stop/restart, paid/external provider calls or remote CI operations. No new tier, parallel validation runner, removed checks, altered inheritance/prerequisites, raised budgets or hand-edited historical IDs/bindings/ledgers. No canonical skill edits, mirror writes, independent application reviewer or implementation of Task #53/#56/#57. Narrow runtime-port documentation/configuration corrections are allowed; unrelated CI/application refactoring is not.
steps: Reconcile actual delivered prerequisites and current state; prepare/provision this normal plan, reconcile exact native payload and preflight under existing owner-selected scope before edits.
Implement bounded configured PORT validation and strict development/preview binding in existing API and both Vite configs without changing artifact routing or restarting live services.

Integrate one canonical owned-server adapter into actual photo export and outline harnesses with ephemeral allocation, collision denial/retry, service-specific finite readiness, independent supervision, bounded output and verified wrapper/descendant teardown.
Connect inventory diagnostics to canonical read-only discovery; extend registered owning suites for real callers, negative readiness and cleanup, sentinel protection and scanner classification.

Execute two complete sequential full standard-tier runs on the delivered snapshot with no manual process/port/lease intervention, preserve raw outcomes and publish requirement-to-delivery handoff with C01–C12 and capability gates.
